# A round pub table (0.56 m across, 0.7 m tall) on a pedestal and cross foot, with a pint of ale
# (an orange glass with a white head) on a peach coaster. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, origin on
# the floor.
new
material new Top --base-color 0.6275 0.3137 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Foot --base-color 0.5020 0.0000 0.0941 --no-slot
material new Ale --base-color 1.0000 0.5020 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Head --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material new Coaster --base-color 1.0000 0.7529 0.5020 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Top --vertices 12 --radius 0.28 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 0.675
material assign Top
add mesh cylinder --name Post --vertices 6 --radius 0.05 --depth 0.62 --location 0 0 0.34
add mesh cube --name FootA --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.0250
scale 0.5000 0.0800 0.0500
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name FootB --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.0250
scale 0.0800 0.5000 0.0500
apply --scale
select Post FootA FootB
material assign Foot
add mesh cylinder --name Coaster --vertices 8 --radius 0.07 --depth 0.012 --location 0.08 -0.05 0.706
material assign Coaster
add mesh cylinder --name Ale --vertices 8 --radius 0.045 --depth 0.13 --location 0.08 -0.05 0.777
material assign Ale
add mesh cylinder --name Head --vertices 8 --radius 0.05 --depth 0.035 --location 0.08 -0.05 0.86
material assign Head
select Top Post FootA FootB Coaster Ale Head
active Top
join
select Top
active Top
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 && pos.z < 0.02"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export sidetable.glb
